name: Nanami Shirone
source:
A new model of android developed by [url=/c50106]Sara[/url] called “TRINO,” who resembles [url=/c50107]Shun's[/url] little sister. 

Although she has a human-like exterior, her cognitive abilities are still developing, making it difficult for her to understand social cues. Despite this drawback, she exudes a unique charm that gives those around her a soothing presence, almost like a living mascot.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=916829]Getchu[/url]]
